entries: Use case: stylized-concept. Production horror game sprite sheet for deadroad.io. ONE CRAWLER zombie, emaciated hairless decayed human in shredded brown trousers, torso low to ground, crawling on elbows and hands with useless legs dragging behind. Frightening realistic richly textured painted 3D survival horror artwork, mottled dead skin, filthy torn cloth, snarling face. Genuine transparent alpha background, no floor, no text, no borders. Uniform 4 columns by 2 rows, eight equal cells. Same identical creature in eight sequential crawl cycle poses, alternating left and right reaching arms and pulling torso forward, trailing legs. Elevated top-down three-quarter camera facing screen bottom, fixed camera scale and center across all frames, full body in each cell with transparent margins. No cartoon or geometric illustration.

Use case: stylized-concept. Non-graphic survival horror game animation sprite sheet. Undead RUNNER with intact pale grey skin, eerie sunken eyes, gaunt silhouette, worn dark red athletic vest and dusty black pants. Rich realistic fabric and skin texture, cinematic game art. No blood, no wounds, no exposed anatomy. Exactly four columns and two rows of eight consecutive running frames of same character. Alternating feet and opposing arm swing. Elevated three-quarter camera looking down, faces screen bottom in every frame. Fixed scale and registration. Full body inside every equal cell with ample empty padding. Transparent alpha background, no floor or shadow, no labels or text.

Subject: ZOMBIE KING boss, supernatural rat-king concept made of FIVE undead humans fused and phased into one crawling lumbering mass. Five distinct eerie heads at different heights, intersecting shoulders and torsos, many tangled arms bracing on ground, multiple legs taking weight-bearing staggered steps. Intact leathery ashen skin and filthy layered tattered civilian clothing, NO gore, NO exposed organs. A cohesive broad terrifying body silhouette, not separate people standing in a group. Eight sequential heavy locomotion frames preserving same arrangement of fused bodies, alternating support arms and legs. No literal royal crown, the cluster of heads forms its crown.
